# Switchremote

> Switchremote is a free job board that lists remote jobs freshers can apply for. No signup and no fees. Jobs are gathered from company career pages and remote job boards, and refreshed every 6 hours. Each listing links to the original source, where people apply.

Switchremote does not hire, does not collect applications, and does not promise that any listing is genuine. Listings stay up for 14 days.

## Jobs

- [All remote jobs](https://switchremote.world/): The full list
- [India](https://switchremote.world/remote-jobs-india.html): Remote jobs freshers in India can apply for

- [Vietnam](https://switchremote.world/remote-jobs-vietnam.html): Remote jobs freshers in Vietnam can apply for
- [Malaysia](https://switchremote.world/remote-jobs-malaysia.html): Remote jobs freshers in Malaysia can apply for
- [Thailand](https://switchremote.world/remote-jobs-thailand.html): Remote jobs freshers in Thailand can apply for
- [Any country](https://switchremote.world/remote-jobs-worldwide.html): Remote jobs open to freshers in any country

## Tools

- [Post a job](https://switchremote.world/post-a-job.html): Employers can post remote fresher and intern roles for free
